subtopics.title: Evaluation Criteria
subtopics.summary: Defines the standards used to assess AI systems, including domain-specific capabilities like math and reasoning, generation quality, instruction-following, and operational factors such as cost and latency.

subtopics.title: Model Selection
subtopics.summary: The process of choosing the right foundation model for an application, covering the build-versus-buy decision and how to navigate public benchmarks to narrow down candidates.

subtopics.title: Design Your Evaluation Pipeline
subtopics.summary: A step-by-step guide to creating a custom evaluation pipeline, including evaluating all system components, creating evaluation guidelines, and defining evaluation methods and data.
